remarks: Stunningly remodeled to today's tastes! Recently updated (2327 Living sq. ft) with the City of Norwalk to be 5 BRs and 3 Full Baths including legalized 1 BR, with Eat-in Kitchen and 1 full bath in walkout Lower Level- separate entry. Main Level, Modern Eat in Kitchen with quartz countertops and waterfall island opens to Living Room, Home Office and Dining Room which has sliders to deck. All new SS appliances and spacious storage pantry. Main level has 1 BR plus full bath which completes the first floor. Second floor has Primary Bedroom with skylight and vaulted ceilings and accesses full bath. 8ft doors. 2 Additional Bedrooms plus a walk in heated and floored storage room. Laundry Room is accessed from both main level and lower level. New features include, new roof & siding, new paved driveway. Oversized 2 Car EE garage with new doors, high ceilings and side door. Hardwood floors in most areas & Recessed lighting throughout. Good for owner occupied or investors! (Ductless Split Unit AC is in the process of being installed).
